definitions: To copy or simulate the actions, appearance, or mannerisms of someone or something.
To produce a copy of something, especially a work of art or a product, often with the intention to deceive.
To resemble or look like something else.
examples: The artist tried to imitate the style of the old masters.
Some birds can imitate human speech.
The fabric was designed to imitate silk.
pastTenses: imitated (simple past), imitated (present perfect), imitated (past perfect)
